2: How quickly this ship gains speed. The higher a ship's mass (including the mass of any cargo or fighters it is carrying), the slower it accelerates.
3: Modifies the ship's acceleration by the given factor.
4: Cooling provided per second when running at full strength. Active cooling requires energy, but if your heat level is low it runs at a lower cooling rate and lower energy draw. The amount of cooling is proportional to the temperature of your ship, reaching the full level only if you are about to overheat.
5: Energy consumed per second when firing this afterburner.
6: Shield damage dealt to the ship per second when firing this afterburner.
7: Hull damage dealt to the ship per second when firing this afterburner.
8: Fuel consumed per second when firing this afterburner.
9: Accumulated shield discharging per second when firing this afterburner.
10: Accumulated hull corrosion per second when firing this afterburner.
11: Accumulated ionization per second when firing this afterburner.
12: Accumulated scrambling per second when firing this afterburner.
13: Accumulated leaking fuel per second when firing this afterburner.
14: Accumulated exothermic interactions per second when firing this afterburner.
15: Accumulated engine interference per second when firing this afterburner.
16: Accumulated shield interference per second when firing this afterburner.
17: Heat created per second when firing this afterburner.
19: Allows scanning of asteroids. The range of this asteroid scanner is proportional to the square root of this value.
20: This type of scanning cannot be performed by your ship, but this outfit might be useful for certain missions.
21: A ship with this attribute does not need any crew to operate, even if it has outfits that normally require additional crew. However, you cannot use it as your flagship in this state.
22: The number of people (passengers or crew) your ship can hold.
23: Protection provided against burn damage. Increases by the given factor how much burn damage a ship can withstand before its heat rises as much as an unprotected ship.
25: Energy consumed per second when resisting burn damage.
26: Fuel consumed per second when resisting burn damage.
